title: Spring Boot Bean Not Found Error

message.text:
Why am I getting this error when I try to run the application?
Description:

Field liftingExerciseService in dev.jclawlor.FitnessGoals.controller.LiftingExerciseController required a bean of type 'dev.jclawlor.FitnessGoals.service.impl.LiftingExerciseServiceImpl' that could not be found.

The injection point has the following annotations:
	- @org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired(required=true)


Action:

Consider defining a bean of type 'dev.jclawlor.FitnessGoals.service.impl.LiftingExerciseServiceImpl' in your configuration.
